$comment: Read by tooling/ci/assert-web-cache-policy.mjs (the site CSP limb, rv2-security-005 / O-EXT-CONNECT-CSP-HAS-NO-READER). Every static deploy root (sites/* with an index.html) is declared in scope or out of scope, both ways. An in-scope site's /* Content-Security-Policy and every declared per-path override are floored; an undeclared override fails; a declared override whose block no longer sets a CSP fails; a declaration the tree no longer matches is COVERAGE LOST.

inScope.why: Served at https://nikatru.com, the same origin as every Flutter web app and its session token in web storage (ADR 075), so an XSS on any page of the site reaches every app.

outOfScope.why: A separate origin (rajasekarselvam.com) holding no app session; its policy carries script-src 'unsafe-inline' by design and rv2-security-005 scopes this limb to nikatru.com only.

overrides.why: The browser-extension link page signs in against GoTrue and asks the platform Worker for a one-time code, so it alone needs connect-src https://auth-api.nikatru.com and https://platform.nikatru.com; the global policy is detached and restated whole, because Cloudflare joins a header two rules set and a browser enforces every CSP it receives.
